snippet.title: FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Full metal schoolgirl destroys a exploitative enterprise! (...with live streaming)
“FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL” Coming October 23rd, 2025!

A fully armed cyborg heroine storms into a giant corporation and unleashes a relentless barrage of gunfire and sword action in this exhilarating cyborg schoolgirl action adventure.
New heroines battle in a game that combines the close combat of "Onechanbara” with the gun battles of “Earth Defense Force.”

PRE-ORDER NOW:
▼PlayStation®5
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012949

▼Nintendo Switch™ 2
https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/full-metal-schoolgirl-switch-2/

▼Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3696410/

▼Epic Games Store
https://store.epicgames.com/p/full-metal-schoolgirl-e7df87

■Spec
Title: FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL
Platforms: Nintendo Switch™ 2 / PlayStation®5 / Steam / Epic Games Store
Release date: October 23rd, 2025
Genre: Action Shooting
No. of players: 1
Ratings: ESRB M / PEGI 16
Developer: YUKE’S Co., Ltd.
Publisher: D3PUBLISHER Inc.
